scope: Actual Windows executable with compile-time ui-test picker adapter. Text/Markdown, text-layer PDF (pdfTest) or DOCX (docxTest) import, atomic document failure/duplicate checks, retrieval and source display, DE/EN, injection as inert text, no evidence, missing model, workspace scope, lock, cancelled authentication, recovery, graceful close/restart. Optional sequential real BGE embedding/index and reranker test identified by embeddingTest. Combined model residency and stream lock are covered only when combinedModels is true. OS picker not included; optional actual answer generation/streaming identified by generationTest.
